def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    by_offset = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value:
                offset = c - r
                if offset in by_offset and by_offset[offset] != value:
                    raise ValueError('conflicting colors on one diagonal')
                by_offset[offset] = value
    offsets = list(by_offset)
    if not offsets:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    max_period = max(max(offsets) - min(offsets) + 1, len(offsets))
    mapping = None
    for period in range(1, max_period + 1):
        candidate = {}
        valid = True
        for offset, color in by_offset.items():
            residue = offset % period
            if residue in candidate and candidate[residue] != color:
                valid = False
                break
            candidate[residue] = color
        if valid and len(candidate) == period:
            mapping = (period, candidate)
            break
    if mapping is None:
        raise ValueError('no fully specified periodic diagonal pattern')
    period, colors = mapping
    return [[colors[(c-r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    return [[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in text.strip().splitlines()]
